cases.case_label: Founder 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN 3' UTR
cases.mechanism_detail: Ancestral 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3' non-coding region of FKTN found on 87% of FCMD chromosomes; the abstract does not name the element class or describe the molecular mechanism. Probands homozygous for it had milder phenotypes than compound heterozygotes with a point mutation.
cases.quote: Most FCMD-bearing chromosomes examined to date (87%) have been derived from a single ancestral founder, whose mutation consisted of a 3 kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3' non-coding region of the fukutin gene.

cases.case_label: Novel non-founder L1 insertion in FKTN
cases.mechanism_detail: One of four novel non-founder FKTN mutations was an L1 insertion; location and effect are not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: identified four novel non-founder mutations in five of them: one missense, one nonsense, one L1 insertion and a 1 bp insertion.
